override._why: The front end is a tutorial in Tony's office ('Look UP using the right thumbstick', from about 30 s), which needs the right stick; Start opens Options and A only goes deeper, and Y is Back on these screens. Y three times exits the tutorial from any of them (Options > Options and Profiles > office > Exit Tutorial); the game then loads, and the defaults skip the opening credits into the mansion shootout. Three in-game frames are needed for the early stop, so play is seen for longer.
